scripts.bootstrap: pnpm auth:check && tsx scripts/runAlchemy.ts cloudflare bootstrap
scripts.plan: pnpm auth:check && pnpm bootstrap && pnpm check && tsx scripts/runAlchemy.ts plan --stage dev alchemy.run.ts
scripts.deploy: pnpm auth:check && turbo build --filter=@math-games/web && pnpm bootstrap && pnpm check && tsx scripts/runAlchemy.ts deploy --stage dev alchemy.run.ts
scripts.destroy: pnpm auth:check && pnpm bootstrap && pnpm check && tsx scripts/runAlchemy.ts destroy --stage dev alchemy.run.ts
